name: air_handling_unit_moist_air
title: Air handling unit with moist-air conditioning
summary: Room supplied with outdoor air through an air handling unit: supply state from the room sensible and moisture loads, cooling coil by contact effectiveness with post-heating; computes coil capacity, post-heating power and condensate flow.

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/humidair2.EES, EES 9.920), via tools/compare_solution.py on the _coolsolve variant
verification.notes: 37 common variables, 26 differ (rtol=0.001). Per-kg-dry-air quantities within 0.5 % (humidity ratios 0.25-0.46 %, enthalpies 0.14-0.32 %); v_a_su +0.96 % (EES vs CoolProp humid-air formulation, checked against ideal gas) propagates to M_dot_a -0.96 %, Q_dot_pc -1.11 %, Q_dot_batt -0.56 %, M_dot_w_cond -0.38 %. Dry-air absolute enthalpies differ by reference-state offset (EES 0 K); their difference Q_dot_pc_bis within 1.13 %.
